newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Elec. sees Pt Beach nuke on line by wknd.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Elec. sees Pt Beach nuke on line by wknd.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co said Tuesday its 485 megawatt (MW) Point Beach 2 nuclear unit would likely restart in "the next few days" and return to the grid by the weekend.
The unit, in Two Rivers, Wisc., is expected to reach full power by late next week.
The unit has been shut since early October for refueling and the replacement of steam generators.

The utility has previously said the adjacent unit 1, also rated at 485 MW, would restart within two to three weeks of unit 2 reaching full power. This unit has been off line since February for refueling and maintenance.
Wisconsin Electric, a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp, provides service to about 2.3 million people in southeastern Wisconsin.
